summary: One focused behavior: author the section 22 four-channel story payload inside the section 38 budget - 8-12 radio messages, 10-16 keep-or-delete-classified fragments, 6-10 no-text props, 3-5 landmarks with visible history, 1-2 institutional timeline contradictions, and 2-4 section 51 traces per major late reveal (none naming it) - delivered through the existing showRadio triggers and production world data, no new delivery systems. AC-enc-story is carried verbatim from ST-04, whose four criteria its four children cover verbatim. Changed responsibilities are within the cap and concrete: world content data (radio table, fragments, props, landmarks, traces), trigger system (radio trigger entries), plus headless scenario-test evidence. Verification is focused on this behavior: a node content check (budget counts, per-fragment classification, per-reveal trace coverage), a fresh-save delivery scenario (each radio trigger fires on its authored condition; contradictions reachable by physical route), and the section 68 id-only spoiler audit; WI-04b is named final proof owner of AC-enc-story. Budget numbers, keep-or-delete categories, and trace rules match request sections 38 and 51 verbatim. Recorded assumption: where the private reveal map assigns a radio to a beat/puzzle completion flag (id-style names owned by WI-04a/WI-04d), the node-level proof seeds the flag through the simulation's public storyFlags (precedent: save.test.ts), while physical milestone reachability stays owned by WI-04a/WI-04c scenarios - preserving ST-04's parallel WI-04b design; if flag gating is needed, the minimal storyFlag gate condition is an allowed 'extend, do not rebuild' trigger-system addition, not a new delivery system.
